guarantees.claim: For each i in [0, NumSlicesCtr-1], log_ctr_we[i] is assigned a Sp2VWidth-bit vector with LSB equal to ctr_we[i] and higher bits zero.
For all i and j in generate ranges, int_ctr_we[j][i] equals log_ctr_we[i][j], yielding int_ctr_we[0][i] = ctr_we[i] and other bits 0.
For all i and j, log_iv_we[i][j] equals int_iv_we[j][i].
For each i, iv_we_o[i] is the type-cast of the Sp2VWidth-bit vector log_iv_we[i] to sp2v_e enumerated type.

assumptions.claim: The combination of int_iv_we[j][i] bits forming log_iv_we[i] must correspond to a legal sp2v_e enumeration value.
assumptions.cond: when iv_we_o is observed by downstream logic
assumptions.risk: An illegal enum value on iv_we_o may cause undefined FSM behavior or misrouted write enables.

uncertain_points.claim: log_ctr_we[i] = {ctr_we[i]} zero-extends a 1-bit signal to Sp2VWidth bits; it is unclear if replication was intended instead.
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream logic using the full width of int_ctr_we may misinterpret the write-enable pattern.

uncertain_points.claim: No check ensures that the bit pattern from int_iv_we is a legal sp2v_e value before the cast on iv_we_o.
uncertain_points.cond: when int_iv_we carries a non-standard pattern
uncertain_points.risk: Corrupted or malicious int_iv_we could yield an invalid enum, compromising control integrity and slice write access.

uncertain_points.claim: The source of int_iv_we is outside this chunk; must verify that it never produces illegal sp2v_e bit patterns.
uncertain_points.risk: If upstream logic can drive invalid bit patterns, U2 becomes a real fault.

uncertain_points.claim: Sp2VWidth is used as the loop bound and the width of log_iv_we; if it does not equal $bits(sp2v_e), the cast may be miswired.
uncertain_points.cond: when parameter configuration mismatches sp2v_e width
uncertain_points.risk: Miswiring could swap/hang bits in iv_we_o.
